nodes.description: Address that receives collected ETH fees; mutable via setTreasury and writable through delegatecall storage takeover.
Mapping tracking ETH fee charged per user, updated after the external ETH transfer.
Private owner address inherited from Ownable; controls privileged functions.
Initializes treasury with a non-zero address check and registers the deployer as owner.
Owner-only function that replaces the treasury address and emits TreasuryChanged.
Payable entrypoint that delegatecalls an arbitrary target/data, then charges an ETH fee.
Internal helper that strips the selector and reverts with the decoded string reason.
Internal helper performing a raw ETH call to a recipient and requiring success.
Returns the current owner address from Ownable.
Owner-only function that sets the owner to the zero address.
Owner-only function that transfers ownership to a new non-zero account.
Private function that writes the owner slot and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Context helper returning msg.sender.
Context helper returning msg.data.
Caller-controlled address used for the fee mapping key and the onlyOwner check.
Arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied target with user-supplied calldata, executed in this contract's storage context.
Raw ETH transfer to an address, executed before the userFeeCharged state update.
Inline assembly pointer arithmetic followed by a raw revert with decoded string data.
Modifier enforcing owner() == _msgSender() before privileged functions execute.
Constructor parameter holding the initial treasury address.
setTreasury parameter holding the new treasury address.

executeSwap parameter holding the delegatecall calldata.
decodeRevert parameter holding raw revert bytes.
safeTransferETH parameter holding the ETH recipient address.
safeTransferETH parameter holding the ETH amount to send.

Local bool capturing the success flag of the ETH transfer call.
Local bytes holding the delegatecall return/revert data.

Local address caching the previous owner for the OwnershipTransferred event.

edges.reason: Constructor derives the initial owner from msg.sender via _msgSender.
Ownable constructor invokes _msgSender to obtain the deployer address.
Constructor writes the validated treasury parameter into the treasury state variable.
Constructor parameter flows directly into the treasury storage slot.
setTreasury overwrites the treasury state variable with a caller-supplied address.
setTreasury parameter becomes the new treasury address.
Previous treasury is read before the privileged write.
onlyOwner guards setTreasury against unauthorized callers.
onlyOwner reads owner() for the authorization comparison.
msg.sender is compared against owner() in the onlyOwner check.
msg.sender is the caller of executeSwap and is used for fee accounting.
executeSwap performs an arbitrary delegatecall to an externally supplied target.
User-controlled target parameter is used as the delegatecall destination.
User-controlled calldata parameter is forwarded to the delegatecall.
Delegatecall executes in this contract's storage context, allowing the treasury slot to be overwritten.
Delegatecall can overwrite the inherited owner storage slot and seize the contract.
Failed delegatecall triggers decodeRevert on the returned bytes.
Delegatecall return data is passed into decodeRevert.
decodeRevert parameter is decoded and reverted on.
decodeRevert uses inline assembly pointer arithmetic and a raw revert.
executeSwap calls safeTransferETH to pay the fee.
treasury state variable is used as the ETH recipient inside the external transfer helper.
safeTransferETH performs an external ETH call to a recipient before user accounting is updated.
Recipient parameter of the external call directly controls the callee that can reenter.
Value parameter determines the ETH amount forwarded by the call.
Success flag of the ETH transfer is captured in a local variable.
userFeeCharged is written after the external ETH transfer, enabling reentrant fee manipulation.
executeSwap increments userFeeCharged by msg.value.
msg.sender is the key used to record the charged fee.
Caller-controlled msg.sender drives the fee flow that surrounds the external call.
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
onlyOwner guards renounceOwnership.
renounceOwnership sets the owner slot to the zero address.
onlyOwner guards transferOwnership.
transferOwnership delegates the storage write to _setOwner.
New owner parameter flows into the ownership write.
_setOwner writes the _owner state variable.
Previous owner is cached before the ownership slot is overwritten.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter is only used to initialize the treasury state variable inside the constructor.
setTreasury parameter exists solely to supply the privileged treasury write.
Target parameter is consumed directly by the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Calldata parameter is consumed directly by the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Revert-bytes parameter exists only to feed the decodeRevert helper.
Recipient parameter controls the unsafe external ETH call destination.
Value parameter controls the amount sent by the unsafe external ETH call.
New owner parameter is only used by transferOwnership to update ownership.
Success flag local variable is produced by the unsafe external call and immediately checked.
Return-data local variable is only forwarded to decodeRevert after a failed delegatecall.
Old treasury local variable exists only to emit the event inside setTreasury.
Old owner local variable exists only to emit the event inside _setOwner.
